findings.effect: The new loop skips null values instead of adding them to unsetFields, so PATCH requests can no longer clear description, plannedDurationHours, startedAt, dueAt, completedAt, or gamify. Users receive a success response, but the old value stays.

Comparing calendar days drops due-date changes that only change the time, causing the whole batch to fail with no_change if that is the only operation. The comparison also uses the server's local timezone, so whether two instants count as the same day depends on where the server runs.
